This dataset contains a line defining the edges of the City's legal jurisdiction.

Data currency

This data in City systems is updated frequently in the normal course of business, however priorities and resources determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the database. The extract on this website is updated weekly. This data feature rarely if ever changes.

Data accuracy

Some of the City's data is created using survey accuracy however some features are not as precise
